name: deduplicate
description: Remove exact duplicate sources, or check a model's meaning clusters: one meaning keeps every source that reports it, and a source is counted once.
value: Remove exact duplicate sources, or check a model's meaning clusters: one meaning keeps every source that reports it, and a source is counted once.

source.notes: Sources array or {sources}; without clusters, deduplication uses exact URL and text.

clusters.notes: A model step's {clusters:[{topic, summary, sources}]}; sources are item numbers n (preferred) or exact URLs. Every one must be a selected source, a source may be in one cluster only, every cluster needs a topic and at least one source; any violation fails. Clusters are ranked by independent outlets, then the model's order.

maxClusters.notes: With clusters, keep the first 1..20 clusters; default 8.

clusters.notes: With clusters: {clusters:[{rank, modelRank, topic, summary, independentOutlets, sources}], sources (the kept clusters' sources, each with its cluster rank), removed, droppedClusters, unclustered, sourceHash}.
